change: Fixed-size saturating counters on the immutable physical capture record measure capture/activation admission attempts, SQL scope derivation, authority acquisition, SQL reacquisition, footprint revalidation and refusal classes. Service retains the existing metadata retry helper and blocking Store dispatch, aggregating dispatch/execution/outside-Store time and refusal counts. It emits one summary per returned retry phase after Store guards have been released. No packet trace, durable-state change, additional permission or retry of the physical effect.
checks_pending: Run the one new focused Store case with actual SQL mutex contention, retained media-reader contention, foreign SQLite transaction refusal, successful projection and idempotent duplicate projection.
Compile the Service integration for the new phase-summary wrapper on local ARM.
diagnostic_semantics: Admission counters describe only the complete footprint acquisition boundary; admitted does not mean the following SQL transaction committed.
Service store_execution_us includes admission plus the remaining Store body. SQL transaction/commit latency is not independently isolated by this change.
outside_store_us is the phase elapsed residual after measured dispatch and Store execution; it includes retry sleep, async wakeup and local accounting, not a pure sleep metric.

Capture-owned counters are bounded in storage and saturate. Concurrent snapshots are best effort; use a returned phase after its Store calls for analysis. No logging or JSON serialization occurs inside SQL/authority/native registry custody.
